Ezali determinant ('more money') to akoki kozala na lokuta ('more quickly').
Esalemi kobɛta lɛlɔ malamu.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I need money now.
dialogue.translation: Na mposa mbongo lɛlɔ.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Here is your card. Go there with your ID.
dialogue.translation: Wamba ezali karta na yo. Kɔbɔka wandi na biléto na yo.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Will you give me more cash?
dialogue.translation: Ozali kozua kolɛmba mbongo mosokɔ?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Yes, I will give you the money now. Go there.
dialogue.translation: Eh, nakosala yo mbongo lɛlɔ. Kɔbɔka wandi.
